title: CSV rerun pause control
summary: Enable the Launch page CSV rerun Pause button by routing it through the backend-owned rerun control route. The backend accepts action=pause with confirm_pause=true and writes the existing stop_after_current marker so the active row/window finishes and no next CSV row starts.
reason: Operators need a visible CSV rerun pause control during active rerun imports without using Force Stop or changing PowerShell worker semantics.
behavior_before: During an active CSV rerun, the Launch page disabled Pause and Rescan; only Stop After Current or Force Stop could be used.
behavior_after: During an active CSV rerun, Pause is enabled and sends a strict-confirmed backend rerun control request. Rescan remains disabled. The worker-facing marker action remains stop_after_current for compatibility with the current PowerShell loop.
